# Function to calculate Haversine distance
def haversine_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 3958.76  # Earth radius in miles
    phi1 = np.radians(lat1)
    phi2 = np.radians(lat2)
    delta_phi = np.radians(lat2 - lat1)
    delta_lambda = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    a = (
        np.sin(delta_phi / 2) ** 2
        + np.cos(phi1) * np.cos(phi2) * np.sin(delta_lambda / 2) ** 2
    )
    c = 2 * np.arctan2(np.sqrt(a), np.sqrt(1 - a))

    return R * c


# Function to calculate Manhattan distance
def manhattan_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return abs(lat1 - lat2) + abs(lon1 - lon2)


# Function to calculate bearing/direction
def calculate_bearing(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    """Calculate the bearing between two points in degrees (0-360)"""
    lat1 = np.radians(lat1)
    lat2 = np.radians(lat2)
    d_lon = np.radians(lon2 - lon1)

    x = np.sin(d_lon) * np.cos(lat2)
    y = np.cos(lat1) * np.sin(lat2) - np.sin(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.cos(d_lon)

    bearing = np.arctan2(x, y)
    bearing = np.degrees(bearing)
    bearing = (bearing + 360) % 360  # Normalize to 0-360

    return bearing


# Function to extract temporal features
def extract_temporal_features(df):
    df["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(df["pickup_datetime"])
    df["hour"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
    df["day_of_week"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
    df["month"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.month
    df["year"] = df["pickup_datetime"].dt.year
    df["is_weekend"] = (df["day_of_week"] >= 5).astype(int)
    df["is_rush_hour"] = (
        (df["hour"] >= 7) & (df["hour"] <= 9) | (df["hour"] >= 16) & (df["hour"] <= 18)
    ).astype(int)
    # Late night surcharge feature (8pm-6am in NYC taxis)
    df["is_late_night"] = ((df["hour"] >= 20) | (df["hour"] < 6)).astype(int)
    # Cyclical encoding for hour and day_of_week
    df["hour_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["hour_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["hour"] / 24)
    df["day_of_week_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)
    df["day_of_week_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["day_of_week"] / 7)
    df["month_sin"] = np.sin(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    df["month_cos"] = np.cos(2 * np.pi * df["month"] / 12)
    return df

    # Filter passenger count
    df = df[(df["passenger_count"] > 0) & (df["passenger_count"] <= 6)]
    # Filter trips with zero or very short distance (likely errors)
    df = df[df["distance"] > 0.01]
    return df
